tools.name: gha_workflows
tools.description: Every GitHub Actions workflow a repository has, with whether it is active. Get owner and name from the repository's git remote.

owner.description: The user or organisation, e.g. nodelike.

tools.name: gha_runs
tools.description: Recent workflow runs for a repository, newest first, with their status and conclusion. Narrow by workflow, branch, status or event.

owner.description: The user or organisation, e.g. nodelike.

workflowId.description: Only runs of this workflow. Its id comes from gha_workflows.

status.description: Only runs in this state, or with this conclusion.

event.description: Only runs started this way, e.g. push, pull_request, schedule, workflow_dispatch.

actor.description: Only runs started by this GitHub login.

perPage.description: How many runs to return. Default 30.

tools.name: gha_run
tools.description: One workflow run with every job in it and each job's steps, which is how to see exactly which step failed.

owner.description: The user or organisation, e.g. nodelike.

tools.name: gha_job_log
tools.description: The full log of one job, line by line. Use it to read why a job failed. Logs age out of GitHub after a while, which the answer says.

owner.description: The user or organisation, e.g. nodelike.

tools.name: gha_annotations
tools.description: What GitHub flagged in one job: the file, line and message behind a failure. Faster than reading the whole log. checkRunId comes from a job in gha_run.

owner.description: The user or organisation, e.g. nodelike.

tools.name: gha_artifacts
tools.description: What a workflow run left behind, with each artifact's size and whether it has expired.

owner.description: The user or organisation, e.g. nodelike.
